versions.changelog:
guaikei-video-to-script 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Converts raw video transcripts (with filler words and errors) into clean, ready-to-use copy.
- Supports both local video files and links from Douyin, Xiaohongshu, etc.
- Output style and summary can be customized with prompts.
- Designed for scenarios like video-to-text, script extraction, video summarization, subtitle extraction, meeting minutes, educational content, live stream recap, and interview transcription.
- Requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN and network connection.
